entries.zh: 想；思念、惦念所爱之人
entries.en: to think of, to miss (the beloved)

entries.zh: 忆；追忆、记挂所爱之人
entries.en: to remember, to call to mind (the beloved)

entries.zh: 忆着；心里惦记着所爱的人，思之恋之
entries.en: to keep the beloved in mind and long for him

entries.zh: 慕；爱慕而思念
entries.en: to admire, to yearn for

entries.zh: 慕妻子；爱恋妻室儿女
entries.en: to love one's wife and children

entries.zh: 友；兄弟相亲相爱（友爱之道）
entries.en: to love one another as brothers; fraternal love

entries.zh: 友爱；兄弟朋友之间互相亲爱
entries.en: mutual love between brothers or friends; fraternal affection
entries.notes: 西语词头含缩写 her.nos（=hermanos，展开依赖推断）；M、R 两栏读音与「友爱」字面略有出入，释义依词头与汉字互证。

entries.zh: 情；爱恋之情（义存疑）
entries.en: affection, passionate love (uncertain)
entries.notes: 词头 amada cusa 语义不明（疑为 cosa）；M、R 栏读音与「情」的常规读法不合，或原字为「色」，四栏未能互证。

entries.zh: 母子情；母亲疼爱儿女之情（母爱）
entries.en: motherly love; affection between mother and children

entries.zh: 厚情；深情厚意（情爱深厚）
entries.en: to love with deep affection; deep-felt love

entries.zh: 割吊人〔或作挂吊〕；令人牵肠挂肚、萦绕难舍之情
entries.en: an affection that clings to and torments the lover; obsessive longing
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（que per ponde al que ama 疑为 que prende/pena al que ama），释义综合「割吊人」缠挂牵挂之义推定。

entries.zh: 情；情爱、感情（泛指爱）
entries.en: love, affection, feeling

entries.zh: 情意动〔或作情伊动〕；深爱而情动于中
entries.en: to be stirred with deep affection; to love much
entries.notes: 第二、三字读法不一（伊／意未定），释义取「情意发动、爱之深切」与 amar mucho 相合。

entries.zh: 情意厚〔或作情伊好〕；深爱、情谊深厚
entries.en: to love deeply; deep and warm affection
entries.notes: 第三字「好／厚」两读未定，两读均指向「深爱、情厚」。

entries.zh: 春心；萌动的春情、情欲之心（如女子之态抚爱挑逗）
entries.en: amorous desire, awakened lust; to make caresses like a woman

entries.zh: 嫂教人〔原文教、数难辨〕；亲昵抚爱之甚（字义未详）
entries.en: to love with much caressing; wanton fondness
entries.notes: source_H 标 [疑]（教／数难辨），M、R 栏读音与字面不合，释义主要依西语词头「amarla muy acariciando」推定。

entries.zh: 意愿；甘心乐意、真心愿意
entries.en: willingness, heartfelt consent; to love truly

entries.zh: 思慕；思念爱慕，视所爱如己有而念念不忘
entries.en: to long for, to think of the beloved as one's own

entries.zh: 私情外意；男女私情、婚外不端之念（不正经之情）
entries.en: illicit love, secret passion; unchaste desire
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（m enteut 疑为 mente，dezordenada 即 desordenada），依 con desonestidad 与「私情」互证推定。

entries.zh: 思念；挂念所爱之人，念念不忘、常挂口中
entries.en: to miss, to keep thinking and speaking of the beloved

entries.zh: 思忆；思之忆之，对所爱有所渴慕
entries.en: to think of and long for something

entries.zh: 相痛；夫妻互相疼爱（相疼相惜）
entries.en: to love each other; conjugal love between spouses
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（oen amoadre 疑为 en amor honesto），依「相痛」（互相疼爱）之义与夫妻语境推定。
